t: AI Conscious Awareness: Uncertainty Calibrator — Simple
name: AI Conscious Awareness: Uncertainty Calibrator — Simple
title: AI Conscious Awareness: Uncertainty Calibrator — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A calibrator that keeps an AI's stated confidence honest: it bins predictions by claimed confidence and measures actual accuracy per bin. A model claiming 90% that hits 70% is miscalibrated, and the calibrator proves it with a reliability diagram.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Bayes update: prior 0.3, likelihood 0.8, marginal 0.5 = 0.4800 posterior. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Conscious Awareness & Metaphysical Exploration (Chapter 57)
real_world_basis: Calibration measurement is standard practice in machine learning evaluation.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UCAME awareness log — the chapter's subjective/objective Balance axis scored per session from calibration drift, with the 'consciousness' framing labeled concept and the calibration numbers real.
build_steps: Build: log confidences from day one, calibrate on a held-out set, and republish the curve on every model change.
math_note: Bayes update: prior 0.3, likelihood 0.8, marginal 0.5: 0.4800 posterior [verified]; Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.1: 28 samples [verified]

math_check.label: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.1

safety: Honesty safety: never ship a confidence number that hasn't been calibrated; uncalibrated confidence is a lie with decimals.
how_it_works: Predictions stream in with confidences; the calibrator bins them, computes per-bin accuracy, and publishes the calibration curve plus the expected calibration error. The demo recomputes a Bayes update and an audit sample size.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact

t: AI Conscious Awareness: Metacognitive Monitor — Simple
name: AI Conscious Awareness: Metacognitive Monitor — Simple
title: AI Conscious Awareness: Metacognitive Monitor — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A monitor that watches the AI watching itself: it tracks prediction latency, confidence volatility, and input novelty, and raises a flag when the system is operating outside its training envelope. The flag means 'I don't know this terrain' — the most valuable sentence a machine can say.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Flag-signal entropy at p=0.05 = 0.2864 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Conscious Awareness & Metaphysical Exploration (Chapter 57)
real_world_basis: Out-of-distribution detection and uncertainty monitoring are active, deployed research areas.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UCAME First/Last axis — session open (first input novelty) and close (final trust state) logged per run, with the 'awareness' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: instrument novelty detection before deployment, set flag thresholds on validation data, and wire flags to human review.
math_note: Flag-signal entropy at p=0.05: 0.2864 bits [verified]; Fibonacci backoff step F(12) for retry scheduling: 144 step [verified]

math_check.label: Fibonacci backoff step F(12) for retry scheduling

safety: Safety: a raised flag must pause autonomous action, never just log — the monitor's output is a control signal, not telemetry.
how_it_works: Novelty detectors score each input against the training distribution; volatility trackers watch confidence swings; the monitor fuses them into a single trust flag. The demo recomputes the entropy of the flag signal.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
